'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Colombian peace process]]
***The [[Government of Colombia]] and the [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] (ELN) announce the resumption of peace talks in [[Caracas]], [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombias-government-eln-rebel-group-reestablish-peace-talks-2022-10-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Annexation of Southern and Eastern Ukraine]]
****The [[Federation Council (Russia)|Federation Council of Russia]] unanimously approves the [[annexation]] of Ukraine's [[Donetsk People's Republic|Donetsk]], [[Luhansk People's Republic|Luhansk]], [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Kherson]], and [[Russian occupation of Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Zaporizhzhia]] regions. The annexation documents will now receive final signing by [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-federation-council-ratifies-annexation-four-ukrainian-regions-2022-10-04/ (Reuters)]
***[[2022 Ukrainian southern counteroffensive]]
****[[Ukraine]]'s [[Ukrainian Naval Infantry|35th Marine Brigade]] recaptures the village of [[Davydiv Brid]] in [[Beryslav Raion]], [[Kherson Oblast]], as it continues its ground offensive. The [[Ministry of Internal Affairs (Ukraine)|Ukrainian Interior Ministry]] says that around 3,500 citizens have been freed from [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Russian occupation]] in recent days. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63137061 (BBC News)] 

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[European Union]] adds [[The Bahamas]] and the [[Turks and Caicos Islands]] to [[European Union tax haven blacklist|its tax haven blacklist]], while [[Bermuda]] is removed from the list and [[Anguilla]] is named a "non-cooperative jurisdiction". [https://caribbean.loopnews.com/content/eu-adds-anguilla-bahamas-turks-and-caicos-tax-blacklist (''Caribbean News'')] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**The U.S. death toll from [[Hurricane Ian]] increases to 109, including 105 in Florida. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/10/04/us/hurricane-ian-florida-recovery-tuesday/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Bangladesh]] suffers a severe [[Electrical grid|power grid]] failure, leaving 80 percent of the country without electricity, according to the [[Bangladesh Power Development Board]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/nearly-all-of-bangladesh-without-electricity-after-grid-failure-3402771 (NDTV)]
*Two people are killed and 10 others injured after a [[plane crash]]es in [[Gao]], [[Gao Region]], [[Mali]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/military-airplane-crashes-airport-northern-mali-city-gao-2022-10-04/ (Reuters)]
*Ten people are killed and 11 others are reported missing after an [[avalanche]] in [[Draupadi ka Danda]], [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sports-india-glaciers-avalanches-climate-and-environment-0801e721cfa7da75391854eeea0dc83f (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Same-sex marriage in Slovenia]]
**The [[National Assembly (Slovenia)|Slovenian National Assembly]] codifies the legalization of same-sex marriage and adoption for same-sex couples. [https://www.barrons.com/amp/news/slovenia-parliament-legalises-marriage-adoption-for-gay-couples-01664903107 (''Barron's'')]
'''Science and technology'''
*[[Nobel Prize in Physics]]
**[[Alain Aspect]] of France, [[John Clauser]] of the U.S., and [[Anton Zeilinger]] of Austria are jointly awarded the [[Nobel Prize]] in Physics for "experiments with [[Quantum entanglement|entangled]] photons, establishing the validity of [[Bell's theorem|Bell inequalities]] and pioneering [[quantum information science]]". [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/10/04/europe/nobel-prize-physics-winner-2022-intl-scn/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Coverage of Google Street View]]
**[[Rwanda]] is added to [[Google Street View]]. [https://twitter.com/virtualstreets_/status/1577297281753268225 (Virtual Streets)]
